transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We're here for the package-lock meeting on the live-concert documentary. Let's go through the key items: release territory, running time, credits, and approval requirements. The streaming platform has requested a worldwide 68-minute master for delivery this Friday. The film is currently assembled at 68 minutes and has not yet been publicly released. I'd like each of the responsible production leads to review these items and report any outstanding requirement. Once all three leads have responded, I'll issue the formal settlement action and authorization decision.
